definitions.explanation: A swimming stroke performed face-down with simultaneous arm movements that pull water toward the chest and a frog-like kick. The slowest of the four competitive strokes but efficient for recreational swimming.

notes:
THE FOUR COMPETITIVE STROKES:
・{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (breaststroke) - slowest but energy-efficient
・⟦{背泳|せおよ}ぎ→背泳ぎ：06527_seoyogi⟧ (backstroke) - swum on back
・⟦バタフライ→バタフライ：06544_batafurai⟧ (butterfly) - most demanding
・⟦クロール→クロール：06545_kurooru⟧/⟦{自由形|じゆうがた}→自由形：18120_jiyuugata⟧ (front crawl/freestyle) - fastest

TECHNIQUE:
・⟦{蛙足|かえるあし}→蛙足：noentry⟧ (frog kick)
・⟦キック→キック：08940_kikku⟧ (kick)
・⟦プル→プル：noentry⟧ (pull/arm movement)
・⟦{息継|いきつ}ぎ→息継ぎ：19245_ikitsugi⟧ (breathing)

COMPETITIVE EVENTS:
・50m, 100m, 200m {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (individual events)
・⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦メドレー→メドレー：29924_medoree⟧ (individual medley - IM)
・⟦メドレーリレー→メドレーリレー：noentry⟧ (medley relay)

HISTORY:
・The oldest known swimming stroke
・Japan has produced many Olympic medalists in {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ
・⟦{北島|きたじま}{康介|こうすけ}→北島康介：noentry⟧ won gold in the 2004 and 2008 Olympics

COLLOCATIONS:
・{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (to swim breaststroke)
